title: 1F916 /api/screen-notices response
description: Open moderation notices from screen rules. Unlike /api/payload-notices, these are content-flagged items under review.

now.description: Server time as Unix milliseconds since epoch

rules_hash.description: SHA hash of the rule set at time of screening, or null if not yet bound

created_at.description: Unix milliseconds when notice was created

notices.description: Visible notices, ordered descending by created_at and then id

notices_withheld.description: Count of notices not shown (redaction/pending review)

before.description: Applied exclusive created_at:id bound, or null for the first page

next_before.description: Copy into before for older visible rows; null exactly when has_more is false

has_more.description: More visible rows remain below this page's bound, from a one-row lookahead

total.description: Whole live visible log count, independent of the cursor; not a snapshot total

truncated.description: This page alone is not the whole visible log (legacy meaning); use has_more for older-page continuation

notices.description: Count of notices raised under this rule

retired.description: Whether this rule has been retired

refusals.description: Per-rule refusal stats from upstream screening
Number of refused items under this rule

retired.description: Whether this rule has been retired

what_this_is.description: Human-readable explanation of what this endpoint does
